Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Couple Pairing's "your half" quick-pick now handles multi-select (checkbox) mods correctly — picking one checkbox from a group like a multi-role animation pack shows every sibling checkbox in that group for your partner, not just the one they picked, so they can find their own role's checkbox instead of scrolling the Animations tab. Add a Cancel button for a pending outgoing pairing invite, so a mistyped name/world doesn't get you stuck — you can back out and retype it.
